answer: An agent locks a 70-credit bond on a dune plot, self-assesses timber at 200, pays 20 Harberger tax per epoch; anyone may buy it at that price. Each epoch it sends its timber tally by whisper to an auditor, who checks the dune ledger; a missing whisper or mismatch burns the bond. First fake 38; k-th 38+6(k-1); 1,000 fakes cost 3,035,000 plus 70,000 locked, pool 40,000. Rented-assessment rings burn all. Honest agents pay 38 once and keep the bond.
